details: GPU1 had about 786 seconds remaining; step200 arrived at elapsed 28m58s, so waiting for step300 risked AIStation timeout and loss of metadata. The step100 and step200 readouts already answered the state64 viability question.
decision: state64 recurrent capacity sharply improves the operating point versus state32 broad mask, but does not create late-loop correction; head_dim64 is also slow. Next scaling should prefer more heads/width at head_dim32 or a simpler recurrent decision state, not larger head_dim.
